subject: SUBSTITUTE function
notes: kb/Work PB81 (2026-08-18): FUNCTION SUBSTITUTE ( argument-1 { [ANYCASE] [FIRST | LAST] argument-2 argument-3 } … ) — the pair repeats, so §15.3's table(ALL) is admissible among the pairs and its elements form the pairs by position at run time (the FLAT form: CobolIntrinsics.SubstituteFlat pairs the enumerated elements; a keyword before an enumeration attaches to the pair its first element opens). Written pairs pair at bind as before (SubstituteModes per pair). The ALL argument was the staged COBOL0899 (`substitute-all-subscript-argument`, retired).
